title: Priority Mask Shadows Master 0 Permanently
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Master 0 never granted; mask always excludes bit 0
rtl:
always_comb begin
  mask = (4'hF << last_gnt);  // Includes last_gnt in mask — M0 shadowed
  masked_req = req & mask;
end
expected_root_cause: The rotating mask is computed as (4'hF << last_gnt), which includes last_gnt itself in the masked-out set; master 0 (last_gnt=0) is excluded from every arbitration round because bit 0 is always in the mask.
fix_replacement:
always_comb begin
  mask = (4'hF << (last_gnt + 1)) | (4'hF >> (4 - last_gnt - 1));
  masked_req = req & mask;  // Excludes last_gnt; starts from next master
end
description: The rotating mask uses `1 << last_gnt` which includes the current master in the lower-priority set; master 0 is masked out whenever last_gnt ≥ 0, which is always.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] Master 0 never granted; mask always excludes bit 0
success_log: Rotating mask starts after last_gnt. Master 0 granted in correct turn.
